[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) (n: Nat) : Nat :=
let parts := string.split_on " ";
let x := parts[0].to_nat;
let y := parts[2].to_nat;
n - x - y
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_to_nat_correct
(s: String) (h: s.to_nat.ok)
: s.to_nat.get = s.to_nat :=
by
cases s
refl

lemma split_on_correct
(s: String)
(parts: Array String)
(h: s.split_on " " = parts)
: parts.length = s.split_on " ".length
:=
by
rw [h]
refl

lemma join_correct
(x y: Nat)
(s1 s2: String)
(h1: s1.repr = x.to_string)
(h2: s2.repr = y.to_string)
: (s1.repr ++ " apples and " ++ s2.repr) = (x.to_string ++ " apples and " ++ y.to_string) :=
by
rw [h1, h2]
refl

lemma string_eq_to_nat
(s1 s2: String)
(h: s1.to_nat.ok ∧ s2.to_nat.ok)
: s1.to_nat.get = s2.to_nat.get → s1 = s2 :=
by
cases s1; cases s2
refl
[END]

by

let result := implementation string n
